import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 262144;
    static int L, n, k, Mo, len, bit[] = new int[20], fac[] = new int[N], inv[] = new int[N], cnt[] = new int[N], g[][] = new int[20][N], f[][] = new int[20][N], h[] = new int[20], p[] = new int[20];

    static int pwr(int x, int y) {
        int z = 1;
        while (y != 0) {
            if ((y & 1) != 0) z = (int)((long)z * x % Mo);
            x = (int)((long) x * x % Mo);
            y >>= 1;
        }
        return z;
    }

    static void add(int[] a, int y) {
        a[0] = a[0] + y >= Mo ? a[0] + y - Mo : a[0] + y;
    }

    static void subtract(int[] a, int y) {
        a[0] = a[0] - y < 0 ? a[0] - y + Mo : a[0] - y;
    }

    static void FWT(int[] a, int len) {
        for (int i = 1; i < len; i <<= 1) {
            for (int j = 0; j < len; j += i << 1) {
                for (int k = 0; k < i; k++) {
                    add(new int[]{a[j + k + i]}, a[j + k]);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void IFWT(int[] a, int len) {
        for (int i = 1; i < len; i <<= 1) {
            for (int j = 0; j < len; j += i << 1) {
                for (int k = 0; k < i; k++) {
                    subtract(new int[]{a[j + k + i]}, a[j + k]);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void get_ln(int[] a, int[] b, int n) {
        b[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            b[i] = (int)((long)a[i] * i % Mo);
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                b[i] += Mo - (long)b[j] * a[i - j] % Mo * j % Mo;
                if (b[i] >= Mo) b[i] -= Mo;
            }
            b[i] = (int)((long)b[i] * pwr(i, Mo - 2) % Mo);
        }
    }

    static void get_exp(int[] a, int[] b, int n) {
        b[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            b[i] = 0;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                b[i] += (long)a[j] * b[i - j] % Mo * j % Mo;
                if (b[i] >= Mo) b[i] -= Mo;
            }
            b[i] = (int)((long)b[i] * pwr(i, Mo - 2) % Mo);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        L = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        Mo = sc.nextInt();

        int all = pwr(k, L);
        if ((L & 1) != 0) {
            System.out.println(all);
            return;
        }

        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= L; i++) {
            fac[i] = (int)((long)fac[i - 1] * i % Mo);
        }
        inv[L] = pwr(fac[L], Mo - 2);
        for (int i = L - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            inv[i] = (int)((long)inv[i + 1] * (i + 1) % Mo);
        }

        for (int s = 1; s <= L; s++) {
            cnt[s] = cnt[s ^ (s & -s)] + 1;
        }

        n = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            if (((L >> i) & 1) != 0) {
                n++;
                bit[n] = 1 << i;
            }
        }

        len = 1 << n;

        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            int s = 0;
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (((i >> (j - 1)) & 1) != 0) {
                    s += bit[j];
                }
            }
            g[cnt[i]][i] = inv[s];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= 18; i++) {
            FWT(g[i], len);
        }

        for (int s = 0; s < len; s++) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                h[i] = g[i][s];
            }
            get_ln(h, p, n);
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                p[i] = (int)((long)p[i] * k % Mo);
            }
            get_exp(p, h, n);
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                f[i][s] = h[i];
            }
        }

        IFWT(f[n], len);
        int ans = (int)((long)f[n][len - 1] * fac[L] % Mo);
        ans = (all - ans + Mo) % Mo;
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
